clues.en: 1924–25 satyagraha for the right to use temple roads
Satyagraha town in Kottayam district visited by Gandhiji in 1925

fact.en: The Vaikom Satyagraha (1924–25) protested the ban on oppressed castes using the roads around the Vaikom temple.
